title: Rondò Veneziano
notes: Orchestral debut joining baroque forms with a contemporary rhythm section.

title: La Serenissima
notes: Chamber-like Venetian melodies; the title theme won over British listeners.

title: Scaramucce
notes: More classical writing with marked rhythms; national editions differ in sequence.

title: Venezia 2000
notes: Seamless anthology in two suites; number one in Switzerland.

title: Odissea veneziana
notes: Baroque themes meet expanded electronics; nine-track original includes the extended Tiziano suite.

title: Casanova
notes: Orchestral miniatures and keyboard textures; original Italian sequence differs from overseas Odissea edition.

title: Rapsodia veneziana
notes: Thirteen compact instrumental pieces; issued as Fantasia veneziana in Germany and Austria.

title: Arabesque
notes: Orchestral crossover with electronic keyboards; German Misteriosa Venezia reshuffles and extends the program.
